beforeShellExecution.command: sh -lc 'command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; root=$PWD; while [ "$root" != "/" ] && [ ! -f "$root/.cursor/hooks/afk-git-guard.mjs" ]; do root=$(dirname "$root"); done; [ -f "$root/.cursor/hooks/afk-git-guard.mjs" ] || exit 2; node "$root/.cursor/hooks/afk-git-guard.mjs"'
beforeShellExecution.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$gitCommand = Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (-not $gitCommand) { exit 0 }; $root = (Get-Location).Path; while ($true) { $hook = Join-Path $root '.cursor/hooks/afk-git-guard.mjs'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $hook -PathType Leaf) { break }; $parent = Split-Path -Parent $root; if (-not $parent -or $parent -eq $root) { exit 2 }; $root = $parent }; node $hook"
